title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for monitoring of chronic kidney disease.

HPI
The patient is a 54-year-old male presenting today for a routine evaluation of chronic kidney disease. He reports feeling well overall and denies any acute symptoms such as edema, fatigue, or changes in urinary output. He is compliant with his current medications and has been monitoring his blood pressure at home. He reports no new concerns regarding his renal function at this time.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10mg daily
Hydrochlorothiazide 12.5mg daily

Exam
The patient appears in no acute distress. Vital signs are stable. Heart sounds are regular with no murmurs. Lungs are clear to auscultation. No peripheral edema is noted in the lower extremities. Skin is warm and dry.

Assessment
The patient has chronic kidney disease, currently at stage 1. Renal function remains stable based on recent laboratory results.

Plan
1. Continue current medication regimen.
2. Order follow-up BMP to monitor serum creatinine and GFR.
3. Return to clinic in 6 months for a repeat evaluation of stage 1 chronic kidney disease.
